newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NAB to keep two Yorkshire Bank units.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NAB to keep two Yorkshire Bank units.

text.p: National Australia Bank (NAB) Ltd said on Thursday its Yorkshire Bank Plc had discontinued talks with Lombard Tricity Finance Ltd over the sale of its Yorkshire Bank Retail Services Ltd and Storecard Ltd units.
"Yorkshire Bank...has now decided to develop Yorkshire Bank Retail Services Ltd and Storecard," NAB said.
NAB announced in February it had agreed to sell the units to National Westminster Bank Plc's Lombard Tricity and aimed to finalise negotiations within a month.
The subsidiaries offer finance through selected retailers to customers at the point of sale and had combined net assets of 15 million poungs stg.
NAB did not say how much would be spent developing the point of sale businesses.
